question: Who inaugurated the Chief Minister's Mini Sports Stadium in Madurai district in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udhayanidhi Stalin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chief Minister's Mini Sports Stadium** in **Madurai district** was inaugurated by **Udhayanidhi Stalin** in **March 2025**.
 
• **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, who serves as the **Deputy Chief Minister** of **Tamil Nadu** and the **Minister for Youth Welfare and Sports Development**, led the ceremony as part of the state's mission to decentralize sports infrastructure. ***Hence, the correct answer is Udhayanidhi Stalin.***
 
• The construction of these **mini-stadiums** is a flagship initiative of the **DMK-led government**, fulfilling a poll promise to establish high-quality sports facilities in every **Assembly Constituency** of the state.
